subtitle.line1: Escape to a peaceful jungle retreat.

intro.text1: Hidden between Santa Marta and Minca, our hostel is a place where the rainforest sets the pace. Wake up to birdsong, enjoy fresh tropical breakfasts, unwind in peaceful surroundings, and discover the perfect balance between adventure and relaxation.
intro.text2: Start your day with fresh tropical fruits, end it with a cocktail under the stars, and enjoy the simple pleasures of life surrounded by nature.

discover.title: Explore the Best of Santa Marta
discover.text: From lush jungle trails to white-sand Caribbean beaches, every day brings a new adventure. Discover breathtaking landscapes, charming local villages, and unforgettable experiences just moments from the hostel.
discover.subtitle: Your perfect base for exploring

chamber.name: Chamber
chamber.title: Private Jungle Room
chamber.text: A private space designed to help you unwind after a day of exploration. Enjoy a warm and comfortable room with everything you need to relax, recharge, and experience a peaceful stay in a welcoming atmosphere.
chamber.alt: Private room with a cozy double bed and warm atmosphere

bed.name: Bed
bed.title: Shared Jungle Dorm
bed.text: A comfortable bed in a shared room designed for travelers looking for connection and new experiences. Enjoy your own cozy space while sharing the vibrant and friendly atmosphere of a welcoming hostel.
bed.alt: Shared dormitory with comfortable individual beds

lodge.name: Lodge
lodge.title: Private Garden Lodge
lodge.text: A private retreat surrounded by nature, where time slows down. Relax on your own patio with a hammock, enjoy peaceful moments in the shade, and let yourself be carried away by a calm and unique atmosphere.
lodge.alt: Nature lodge with a private terrace and hammock

location-cta.title: Location
location-cta.text: Perfectly located between the jungle and the Caribbean coast.

terrace.title: A hidden retreat above the jungle
terrace.text: Our terrace offers a peaceful escape surrounded by tropical landscapes, fresh air, and the unique atmosphere of the Sierra Nevada.

garden.title: Nature as your only backdrop
garden.text: Explore a tropical garden where every path reveals new colors, scents, and the hidden wonders of Colombia’s wild landscape.

pool.title: A natural oasis to unwind
pool.text: After a day of adventure through the jungle or along the Caribbean coast, relax and recharge in our peaceful outdoor pool.

adventures.subtitle: Experiences
adventures.title: Every day brings a new adventure
adventures.text1: Whether you're seeking peaceful moments in nature or unforgettable adventures, our location gives you easy access to waterfalls, hiking trails, coffee farms, vibrant Santa Marta and the breathtaking beaches of Tayrona National Park.
adventures.text2: Explore the region at your own pace with unforgettable experiences just minutes away.

jungle.title: Explore the Jungle
jungle.text: Step into the lush tropical rainforest surrounding the lodge. Follow scenic trails, discover exotic wildlife, listen to the sounds of nature, and enjoy breathtaking viewpoints hidden deep within the Sierra Nevada.
jungle.alt: Hiking trail through the jungle near Santa Marta

santa-marta.title: Visit Santa Marta
santa-marta.text: Discover the oldest city in Colombia. Wander through its colorful historic center, enjoy local cafés and restaurants, visit the marina, and experience the vibrant Caribbean atmosphere just a short drive away.
santa-marta.alt: Santa Marta animated beach at night

tayrona-park.title: Tayrona National Park
tayrona-park.text: Spend a day exploring one of Colombia's most iconic national parks. Hike through tropical forests, encounter native wildlife, and reach spectacular beaches such as Cabo San Juan, where the jungle meets the Caribbean Sea.

caribbean-beaches.title: Relax on Caribbean Beaches
caribbean-beaches.text: Escape to the stunning Caribbean coastline and unwind on golden sandy beaches with crystal-clear water. Perfect for swimming, sunbathing, snorkeling, or simply enjoying the peaceful tropical scenery.

footer.text1: Discover a hidden retreat in the Colombian jungle, where comfort, adventure, and nature come together just outside Santa Marta.
footer.text2: A peaceful place to slow down, explore, and experience the beauty of the Caribbean rainforest.
